name: fun-run-finish-line
description: Live finish-line check-in and leaderboard for your fun run.

scripts.test: npm test --workspace backend && npm test --workspace frontend
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run desktop:prepare && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start --workspace backend" "npm run preview --workspace frontend"
